summary: Ferrovial SE filed a Form 6-K reporting the conversion of its legal form from a European Company (SE) to a Dutch public limited liability company (N.V.), effective April 30, 2026, following shareholder approval on April 9, 2026. The name changed to Ferrovial N.V. with amended articles of association. No acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or other special situation is involved; it is a routine corporate restructuring of legal domicile. Shares remain listed and traded on the same exchanges. No financial terms, premiums, or advisors are mentioned. This is a non-extraordinary regulatory filing.
